title: FairyLoot Alternatives: 5 Book Boxes Like FairyLoot - Cratejoy
summary: FairyLoot on a waitlist? Compare five fantasy book boxes like FairyLoot, from signed special editions to monthly hardcover clubs, by price and delivery.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to FairyLoot?


OwlCrate’s YA Fantasy Book & Goodies box. Each month brings a signed YA fantasy hardcover in an OwlCrate edition with four or five themed items, and it’s open to new subscribers.


How does the FairyLoot waitlist work?


Each plan has its own waitlist. When a spot opens, FairyLoot emails an invitation to the next person in line. Activating the subscription doesn’t charge you. The first payment comes on that plan’s renewal day early in the month.


Is there a romantasy box like FairyLoot’s?


OwlCrate runs a quarterly Romantasy box with exclusive editions for $31.99 plus shipping, but it has a waitlist too. LitJoy’s To Bee Read lets you choose between two signed editions each quarter, and romance is among its genres. If you want romance without the fantasy, SplureBox’s Romance Books Club on Cratejoy sends a hardcover romance each month.


Does FairyLoot ship to the US?


Yes. Its US store at us.fairyloot.com charges in dollars and ships to the US and Canada. A single-book plan costs $7 to ship to most of the US and $16 to Canada.


What if I read more than fantasy?


Our[Book of the Month alternatives](https://www.cratejoy.com/blogs/box-insider/boxes-like-book-of-the-month) compare six book boxes across genres, from one-genre clubs to signed romance.
